what: 4. What a built project looks like
title: Using scroll — a guide for an AI agent
text: Store format v2 facts matter: - cell column expr/ int32, 1-based global row index cells.parquet, barcode. - value uint8 quantize = TRUE (default, ~4× smaller, floors values ~max/510), else float32 (exact). quantize = FALSE required scroll_build_stream(). - Everything zstd. One feature-sorted Parquet file per assay; row-group stats prune single-gene query. - nonzero entries stored — absent cell means 0.
code: myproject/ ├── cells.parquet          # one row per cell: cell, <meta…>, <reduction>_<dim>… (zstd) ├── expr/<assay>/part-0.parquet   # long (feature, cell, value); one file per assay ├── counts/<assay>.parquet  # only if counts = TRUE (integer, unquantized) ├── repertoire/             # only if vdj = ├── spatial/<name>.rds      # only if spatial = ├── atac/peaks.parquet      # only if atac = ├── manifest.yaml           # the contract the runtime reads ├── config.yaml             # title, defaults, markers, panel order (hand-editable) └── app.R                   # library(scroll); scroll_app(".")

what: 5. scroll_build() — the arguments you’ll actually use
title: Using scroll — a guide for an AI agent
text: Related build/assemble helpers: - scroll_build_stream(outdir, sources, reader, ...) — multi-source streaming build datasets big RAM (one source time; quantize = FALSE ). - scroll_update(dir, object, ...) — rewrite cells.parquet + manifest (metadata / embeddings), without touching expression store. Fast; doesn’t wipe side-baked dirs. Needs Seurat object. - scroll_add_meta(dir, name, values, scope=, overwrite=) — add one metadata column built project (writes cells.parquet + manifest.yaml), Seurat object needed — ideal deployed app. values can length-n_cells vector, barcode-named vector, data.frame(cell, value), function(cells) deriving existing columns; type (categorical/numeric) inferred. Restart app see . - scroll_add_subset(object, sub_object, name, embeddings, label=, meta=) — attach reprocessed sub-embedding + scoped metadata parent barcode. ⚠️ overwrite = TRUE wipes entire project dir, including subdirectories separate script baked. Re-run side bakes every rebuild, use scroll_update() metadata-changes.
code: scroll_build(object, outdir,              assays = NULL, embeddings = NULL, meta_cols = NULL,              quantize = TRUE,      # FALSE = exact float32              counts = FALSE,       # TRUE unlocks Pseudobulk DE              subsets = NULL,       # named list of subset-view specs (see §7)              vdj = NULL, spatial = NULL, atac = NULL,   # modality specs (§6)              panels = NULL, exclude_panels = NULL,       # override panel gating              overwrite = FALSE)    # ⚠ TRUE wipes the whole outdir

text: article interested obtaining Euclidean distances cells. get need rerun FindNeighbors() return.neighbor = TRUE; otherwise call stores binary adjacency pbmc@graphs$RNA_nn. graph flattened table cell_barcode | neighbour_cell_barcode | distance, saved Parquet table.
code: # 1. k-NN in expression/PCA space, keeping distances (creates pbmc@neighbors$RNA.nn) pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10, return.neighbor = TRUE)  # 2. flatten the neighbour matrices into a long edge list of barcodes nn   <- pbmc@neighbors$RNA.nn              # a Neighbor object idx  <- nn@nn.idx                          # cells x k : neighbour row indices dst  <- nn@nn.dist                         # cells x k : matching distances bc   <- nn@cell.names                      # barcodes, row-aligned to idx / dst k    <- ncol(idx)  edges <- data.frame(   cell      = rep(bc, times = k),          # the seed cell (column-major order)   neighbour = bc[as.vector(idx)],          # one of its k neighbours (barcode)   distance  = as.vector(dst)               # the k-NN distance between them ) edges <- edges[edges$cell != edges$neighbour, ]   # drop self (distance 0) nrow(edges)  dir.create("pbmc3k/neighbours", showWarnings = FALSE) arrow::write_parquet(edges, "pbmc3k/neighbours/RNA_nn.parquet") #> [1] 50122

title: Getting started: from a Seurat object to a running app
text: Subset T cells give embedding: scroll_add_subset() copies child’s reduction chosen metadata onto parent, matched cell barcode (cells outside slice get NA), records view build finds automatically. embeddings argument named vector, new_name = source_reduction: takes reduction called umap tcells stores parent umap_tcell. (prefer, can skip helper pass subsets = list straight scroll_build().)
code: library(Seurat)  tcells <- subset(pbmc, subset = seurat_annotations %in%                    c("Naive CD4 T", "Memory CD4 T", "CD8 T"))  tcells <- NormalizeData(tcells)      |>   FindVariableFeatures()             |>   ScaleData()                        |>   RunPCA()                           |>   RunUMAP(dims = 1:20)               # a fresh UMAP for just these cells  tcells <- FindNeighbors(tcells, dims = 1:20) |> FindClusters(resolution = 0.4) tcells$tcell_subcluster <- tcells$seurat_clusters # attach the sub-embedding + sub-labels onto the parent, matched by barcode pbmc <- scroll_add_subset(pbmc, tcells,                           name       = "tcell",                           label      = "T cells",                           embeddings = c(umap_tcell = "umap"),   # child "umap" -> parent "umap_tcell"                           meta       = "tcell_subcluster")  # rebuild — the recorded subset is picked up automatically scroll_build(pbmc, "pbmc3k", counts = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE)

title: Interactive Single-Cell Explorers from Seurat Objects
text: Interactive single-cell explorers, served infrastructure. scroll turns processed Seurat object polished, interactive web explorer — scrolling page analysis panels (DimPlot, FeaturePlot, Signature, Biaxial, DotPlot, Heatmap, Violin, Proportions, DE, Pseudobulk DE), fine-grained controls. heavy offline build phase extracts lightweight -disk artifacts; runtime (bslib Shiny app) reads , querying expression one feature time via arrow — runtime memory stays flat regardless dataset size. deploys plain app.R open-source Shiny Server, render step. Status: feature-complete MVP validated scale (live 4.4M-cell atlas). Includes two-phase build; eight analysis panels (incl. live DE panel replicate-aware Pseudobulk DE); compact v2 storage format (int32 cell-index + zstd, ~5× smaller v1; lossless quantize = FALSE); scroll_build_stream() streaming multi-million-cell builds laptop; scroll_multi_app() several datasets behind one page; multimodal support (multi-assay, per-cell VDJ / immune repertoire via vdj_spec() — reads TCR/BCR scRepertoire / AIRR-dandelion / Platypus box, spatial tissue-image maps via spatial_spec(), scATAC peaks via atac_spec()); subset views reprocessed sub-embeddings; rich declarative controls (data-derived choices, cascading levels, preferred defaults, palette picker); PNG/PDF/CSV export; rasterization/memoization performance pass; public register_panel() extension point. Documentation: pkgdown site.

title: Interactive Single-Cell Explorers from Seurat Objects
text: scroll_build() writes cells.parquet, feature-partitioned expr/ store, manifest.yaml, starter config.yaml, deployable app.R. Expression quantized uint8 default (quantize = FALSE keep full precision). Quantization floors values ~max/510 zero, fraction-expressing stats (dotplot dot size, DE pct.1/pct.2) slightly -count low expression — use quantize = FALSE exact fractions matter. Storage & precision. expression store compact sparse, answers single-gene queries tens milliseconds even several million cells, lossy precision change (quantize = FALSE). Add counts = TRUE raw-counts store (needed Pseudobulk DE; roughly doubles build size). Projects built older scroll keep working un-rebuilt. Build large datasets (streaming). many samples won’t fit RAM one merged object, scroll_build_stream() reads one source time shared store — peak memory ~per-source, per-dataset — append-safe (re-run data arrives). powers multi-million-cell atlases laptop: Multimodal (CITE-seq / multiome). default object’s default assay exported. Pass assays = include — becomes expr/<assay>/ subtree independent dequantization scale: Every expression panel (FeaturePlot, DotPlot, Violin, DE) shows Assay selector; gene search DE run chosen assay. (Derived assays like SCT integrated exported unless name explicitly.)
code: library(scroll) library(SeuratData)                    # for the pbmc3k example object data("pbmc3k.final", package = "pbmc3k.SeuratData") obj <- SeuratObject::UpdateSeuratObject(pbmc3k.final)  scroll_build(obj, "pbmc3k")            # object -> project directory scroll_build_stream("atlas", sources = as.list(Sys.glob("data/*.h5ad")),   reader = function(f) load_one_sample(f),   # -> a processed Seurat object   assays = "RNA", embeddings = "umap", meta_cols = c("sample", "celltype")) scroll_build(obj, "cite", assays = c("RNA", "ADT"))

Richer declarative controls register_plot_panel(): scroll_input_assay() (auto-hidden single-assay data), scroll_input_embedding() view-aware scroll_input_column(view_aware=) (narrow active subset view), scroll_input_custom() (wrap ui/bind), scroll_show_when() conditional visibility. Reusable render + data helpers exported custom views match built-ins: scroll_point_layer() (raster-aware scatter), scroll_discrete_colors() / scroll_continuous_scale() (shared palettes), scroll_group_labels(), accessors scroll_columns(view=), scroll_embeddings(), scroll_features(). Fewer silent failures. non-ggplot plot return now shows clear message; scroll_input_levels(=) names column/control warns; contradictory required + none warns construction. Data-derived choices. Controls can now compute options data handle instead manifest: scroll_input_choice(choices = function(data)) scroll_input_levels(choices = function(input, data), watch = c(...)) populate e.g. baked asset data$dir, recomputing watched control changes. scroll_input_column(prefer=) sets preferred default column, scroll_input_palette() offers built-discrete/continuous palette names.
